message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "validate_mediastinal_shift_direction_for_opacities", "description": "When interpreting unilateral lung opacification, explicitly verify the direction of mediastinal shift to distinguish between volume-loss (atelectasis) and space-occupying (effusion/mass) etiologies.", "applicable_conditions": "Any chest imaging task involving unilateral opacity, consolidation, or white-out where differential diagnosis includes atelectasis versus pleural effusion or large mass.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier", "chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If a unilateral opacity is identified: (1) Determine the direction of mediastinal shift relative to the opacity. (2) If the shift is ipsilateral (toward the opacity), prioritize atelectasis or fibrosis in the differential. (3) If the shift is contralateral (away from the opacity), prioritize massive pleural effusion or large mass. (4) Ensure the final diagnosis selected aligns with this mechanical relationship before outputting the result."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
